title: API Interview Questions: The Backend & SDE Handbook
summary: Handwritten-style Q&A notes on the API questions backend and SDE interviewers ask most. Covers REST and HTTP, auth, security, pagination, rate limiting, caching, gateways, webhooks, idempotency, versioning, uploads, testing, monitoring, scalability and design scenarios.

chapters.title: API Interview Questions Cover
points: REST, HTTP methods and status codes
Auth with JWT and OAuth 2.0, plus CORS and security
Pagination, rate limiting, caching and gateways
Webhooks, idempotency, versioning, scale and design scenarios

chapters.title: REST and HTTP Fundamentals
points: What is a REST API and what are its core constraints?
What is the difference between REST and SOAP?
What does it mean that REST is stateless, and why does it matter?
What is the difference between REST and GraphQL?

chapters.title: HTTP Methods
points: What is the difference between PUT and PATCH?
What is the difference between GET and POST?
Which HTTP methods are safe and which are idempotent?
Why is PUT idempotent but POST not?

chapters.title: Status Codes and Error Handling
points: What is the difference between 401 and 403?
What is the difference between 400, 404 and 422?
When do you return 200, 201, 202 and 204?
How do you design a consistent error response format?

chapters.title: Authentication and JWT
points: What is the difference between authentication and authorization?

chapters.title: CORS and API Security

chapters.title: Real-World API Design Scenarios
points: How would you design a URL shortener API?
